name: visit_summary_tool
description: Split a patient's longitudinal clinical notes into individual visits (by date) and summarize each visit separately using a local Ollama Qwen model.

runtime.notes: Runs locally against an Ollama server (default http://127.0.0.1:11434) using a Qwen model. One inference call per visit; GPU is used automatically if available.

help.summary: Summarize a patient's clinical notes visit-by-visit (Visit 1, Visit 2, ...) via a local Ollama Qwen model.
notes: Requires a running Ollama server with a Qwen model pulled (set OLLAMA_MODEL / OLLAMA_HOST to override).
Visits are detected from dated note chunks; same-date chunks are merged into one visit.
Upload a .txt clinical note first, then run this tool.
